rating_cap: Filter 4 (RF-CAP-004, Critical, unresolved serial-acquirer pattern) caps the rating at Watchlist per CLAUDE.md §18/§24 and Rating Cap Rules — the most restrictive of the caps that fired; Filter 2 (RF-MGT-004, turnaround without proven inflection) alone would only cap at Starter Position Only.
variant_perception_summary: The reverse-DCF shows the market pricing a ~9%/year normalized FCF decline for six straight years, harsher than guidance or evidence supports past 1-2 years — but the 8-analyst mean target price ($14.88) sits within 3% of this engine's own base case ($15.27), so this is closer to a well-triangulated restatement of sell-side consensus than a proprietary edge (edge score 35/100).
what_everyone_knows: SMPL has had a rough 18 months — four straight quarters of falling revenue, a five-year ~800bps gross-margin decline, a $391.9M cumulative impairment across three of the last four quarters, a CEO/CFO/Controller reshuffle inside 12 months, and a $280M acquisition (OWYN) now 71% written off. The stock trades well below its own five-year multiple history.
what_is_priced_in: A normalized free-cash-flow decline of roughly 9% a year for six straight years — worse than company guidance (1-2 years) and worse than even this engine's own worst labeled structural-bear scenario ($13.09, which still sits above today's price).
what_market_may_be_missing: The length of the priced-in decline (six years) is arithmetically harder to justify than the visible evidence supports — Quest is still gaining household penetration (+120bps to 20.5%, a multi-year high) even as the consolidated business shrinks, and the balance sheet has no maturity wall and $197.8M of liquidity against $0 of near-term obligations, so this is not a survival story dressed as a value stock.
edge_proof: Falsifiable: if the FQ4 FY2026 (Oct-23-2026) and FQ1 FY2027 prints show Quest household penetration continuing to rise, consolidated retail takeaway narrowing its 16.7-point gap to category growth, and the September-2026 price increase landing with elasticity below management's own '1 or higher' fear, the market's implied ~9%/year six-year FCF-decline path will be shown to be too harsh and the stock should re-rate toward the $13.76-$17.53 method cluster; if those signs do not appear, the market's skepticism (not the sell-side's $14.88 mean target) will be shown to be the correct read.
killer_risk: A third material, debt-funded acquisition before OWYN stabilizes — exactly the §24 Filter 4 pattern already tripped once (RF-CAP-004, Critical).
